title: Slope of a line
summary: Two draggable points define a line; the slope updates as you move them.

steps.title: Two points
steps.detail: A and B are free points. The blue line is the unique straight path through both.

steps.title: Rise over run
steps.detail: Slope is (y_B − y_A) / (x_B − x_A). Drag either point and watch the readout change.

steps.title: Special cases
steps.detail: Horizontal means slope 0. Nearly vertical means a huge slope. Same x-coordinates make the slope undefined.
